sos.title: Heatstroke Emergency SOS
sos.subtitle: Immediate first aid & ambulance call
sos.step1.title: Move to Shade Immediately
sos.step1.desc: Get out of direct sun and sit in a cool or shaded area.
sos.step2.title: Loosen Tight Clothing
sos.step2.desc: Loosen collar and apply cool water to forehead and neck.
sos.step3.title: Sip Water with Electrolytes
sos.step3.desc: Drink ORS or salted water in small sips. Avoid gulping ice water.
sos.step4.title: If Dizziness Occurs
sos.step4.desc: Lie down with feet slightly elevated and call for help.
